{{Top|leg}}
Sunberry dust was powered dust made from sunberries. The Ewok Teebo used sunberry dust to perform a magic spell to help a damaged wish plant return to normal, but the spell instead caused leaves to grow on the face of the Ewok Latara.<ref name="2-02">{{Ewoks|The Wish Plant}}</ref>
